app.title: Life Path / Ubuzima
app.subtitle: Rwanda CRVS 2025
intro.title: You are one of 14,108,217 Rwandans
intro.subtitle: Choose your starting identity to walk the 2025 life path.
intro.caption: Rwanda's population in 2025 stands at 14.1M with a youthful median age. Over 50% of the population is under 25 years old.
intro.pyramid_title: Population Structure by Age and Sex (2025)
birth.title: 1 in 356,838
birth.subtitle: Tap to enter the world among every registered newborn of 2025.
birth.sex_ratio: Sex ratio at birth: 102.7 boys born for every 100 girls.
birth.tfr_statement: Rwandan women have about 3.5 children on average.
birth.completeness: Birth registration completeness in Rwanda reached 92.9% in 2025.
birth.caption: In 2025, exactly 356,838 live births were registered across Rwanda (180,795 boys and 176,043 girls).
growing.title: Growing Up Across the Terraced Hills
growing.subtitle: From early childhood into adulthood across the Rwandan landscape.
growing.caption: A generation shaped by expanding primary education, community health workers, and demographic momentum.
marriage.title: Walking Down the Aisle
marriage.instruction: Drag the ring to guess your wedding age, then reveal the real distribution.
marriage.caption: 50,256 marriages were registered in 2025 (crude marriage rate of 3.6 per 1,000 population).
divorce.title: The Rhythm of Separation
divorce.instruction: Guess how long marriages lasted before divorce, then reveal the real peak.
divorce.peak_duration: Divorces peak at 5–9 years of marriage (1,076 cases), followed by 10–14 years (928 cases).
divorce.avg_age_men: Average age at divorce: 43.3 years for men.
divorce.avg_age_women: Average age at divorce: 39.8 years for women.
divorce.caption: 4,479 divorces were registered in 2025 with a crude divorce rate of 0.2 per 1,000 population.
death.title: The Final Horizon
death.instruction: Explore the registered death distribution and leading causes of death.
death.u_shape: A characteristic U-shape: 6,393 deaths occurred at ages 0–4, lowering through youth and surging in later decades.
death.facility_top: Leading facility cause: Perinatal conditions (14.9%), linking directly back to infancy.
death.community_top: Leading community cause: Unspecified cardiac diseases (16.2%) and acute cardiac conditions (11.1%).
death.caption: 39,355 deaths were registered in 2025 (22,051 male, 17,304 female). Registered sex ratio: 127.4 males per 100 females.
outro.title: The Life Path Completed
outro.subtitle: Thank you for exploring Rwanda's 2025 vital statistics.
outro.nisr_citation: All statistics originate from the National Institute of Statistics of Rwanda (NISR) CRVS 2025 Annual Report.
caveat.composite_life: This story represents a composite life path combining the 2025 cross-section with 2019–2025 national trends, rather than a single cohort.
caveat.registered_not_occurring: Registered births reflect officially registered events in 2025 (92.9% registration completeness).
caveat.marriage_registration: Data reflects civil marriages officially registered in 2025 from Table 18 of the NISR CRVS report.
caveat.divorce_not_rate: Registered divorces are not a divorce rate. 4,479 divorces vs 50,256 marriages come from different cohorts, and 41.3% were granted before 2025.
caveat.registered_deaths_completeness: Registered deaths (39,355) represent 50.5% completeness of expected mortality. Labeled strictly as registered deaths, not risk of dying.
